summary: [spec-fidelity] On `artifacts move` a store directory that is a symlink or a file is ARTIFACTS_STORE_UNAVAILABLE with retryable true, where atip.codestored.07 and the brief say a symlinked store directory is ARTIFACTS_STORE_INVALID and only a repeat-able OS error is UNAVAILABLE. Driven: `ln -s <outside> .canon/artifacts/sha256`; `canon artifacts move --tier cold --json` and the `--commit` form -> exit 2 ARTIFACTS_STORE_UNAVAILABLE retryable true ('is not a real directory'); `canon evidence add --artifact` on the same repo -> ARTIFACTS_STORE_INVALID. The same with a regular file at that path. Cause: run_move wraps the `io::Error::other` of `local_blobs` in `ArtifactStoreError::Io`, and `store_code` (artifacts.rs) sends every Io of cause Other or NotFound to UNAVAILABLE (`_ =>` arm), the one place that inverts the rule: `unreadable_blob_code` and `tiers_code` send Other to INVALID. A caller that retries on `retryable: true` loops on a state only a person can mend. Fix: Io of Other, NotFound or WrongPath -> ARTIFACTS_STORE_INVALID; UNAVAILABLE only for Cause::Unavailable; test the symlink through `artifacts move`. Blast radius: every caller of `store_error`/`store_refusal` with an Io (artifacts store, evidence add lock paths).
